stem.text: Which statement about the role of co-transporter proteins in the movement of sucrose is correct?

A.text: Co-transporter proteins pump hydrogen ions into phloem sieve tubes along with sucrose.

B.text: Hydrogen ions diffuse through co-transporter proteins with sucrose into companion cells.

C.text: Plasmodesmata move sucrose into phloem sieve tubes via co-transporter proteins.

D.text: Sucrose is moved through co-transporter proteins by active transport.
